trace_paint_box.name: Hand in / paint kept
trace_paint_box.description: A 60 x 60 x 140 cm drawing volume on a 60 cm plinth. Each tracked hand draws on entry. Tube, ribbon, beads or grid strokes remain after leaving; a dedicated button clears this box.

qfep.focus: A boundary gates recording without erasing its history.
qfep.encounter: The same hand movement becomes different material under four sampling and surface rules.
